entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this piece of junk VeloBand you sold me. It's completely broken and I'm not wasting another second on it.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your device. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's a technical fault! It's defective! The pulse monitor is not working at all, it just gives me a reading of 'zero', and it won't sync with the app. I've tried everything. This product is a scam and I want my money back.
I understand your frustration. A tracker that doesn't track is certainly not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order details to check on the return eligibility.
You'd better. I'm not playing games. If you don't give me a refund, I'll be speaking to your manager and leaving reviews on every single website I can find.
I understand. One moment while I review your account... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered 36 days ago.
And? Don't give me some runaround about the date.
No runaround at all, sir. I've just checked our policy, and you're well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for this defective item for you right now.

Yes, of course. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Huh. Well... okay. That's... better than I expected. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
